title: Supplier fire - Coastal Gasket Works
text:
Subject: Production Update - Coastal Gasket Works

Due to a fire at our Chennai facility on Sept 2nd, all gasket production lines are halted. We expect a minimum 21-day delay before shipments can resume.

- Coastal Gasket Works Ops Team

title: Loosely named supplier
text: Heads up - the Chennai gasket supplier just told us their plant is down for at least three weeks after a fire. Might want to check what's riding on their shipments.

title: Carrier port delay - OceanLink
text: Notice from OceanLink Shipping: due to port congestion at the destination port, vessel arrivals are delayed by approximately 14 days across all active shipments. Tracking ref OL-4471 is affected.

title: Warehouse incident - resin spill
text: Incident report, Warehouse C: a resin drum in the Industrial Resin storage area was found leaking during this morning's inspection. The affected lot has been quarantined pending assessment; extent of loss not yet confirmed.

title: No impact - unrelated company
text: Breaking: Massive explosion reported at Titan Aerospace Components' main plant in Toulouse. Authorities have cordoned off the area. Production impact unknown at this time.

title: No impact - known supplier, nothing pending
text: Pacific Resin Supply informs us of a two-week labor strike starting next Monday, affecting all outbound shipments during that period.
